verdict.rationale: Intel Gaudi 3 is an AI accelerator chip used through a programmatic software stack (Docker images, PyTorch, DeepSpeed, vLLM). It has no product UI whose features an API could match, so API-versus-UI parity is a category error for this kind of product. The cloud-access mention refers to a separate hosting service, and the 404 OpenAPI probes do not create a UI axis.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
